fieldValues.title: An issue closed after its first part makes its dependents look unblocked
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust#1264 closed when part 1 landed (ADR-055: an optional code on ValidationDiagnostic). srs-rust#1491 and #1339 both say 'Blocked by #1264' and reuse a shared Diagnostic type that part 1 never defined. The blocked-by edge read as cleared, so both were ready and were claimed five times between 10-28 and 10-30; every run tripped the guard and stopped.
fieldValues.body: The inverse of 'A closed blocker leaves its dependent labelled blocked'. A remedy would name the deliverable a dependent needs (the type, not the issue) or keep the parent open until its parts land. Settled 2026-10-30: #1491 defines the type; #1339 is blocked by #1491.
